section.title: org.osgi.service.clusterinfo
section.para: ClusterInfo Services Package Version 1.0.

Bundles wishing to use this package must list the package in the Import-Package header of the bundle's manifest. This package has two types of users: the consumers that use the API in this package and the providers that implement the API in this package.
Example import for consumers using the API in this package:
Example import for providers implementing the API in this package:

section.title: Summary

listitem.para: ClusterTagPermission - A bundle's authority to add a tag to a NodeStatus service.
FrameworkManager - Provides a management interface for accessing and managing a remote OSGi framework.
FrameworkNodeStatus - The FrameworkNodeStatus service represents a node in the cluster that is also an OSGi framework.
NodeStatus - The NodeStatus service represents a node in the cluster.

section.title: public interface FrameworkNodeStatus extends NodeStatus, FrameworkManager
section.para: The FrameworkNodeStatus service represents a node in the cluster that is also an OSGi framework.

section.title: public interface NodeStatus
section.para: The NodeStatus service represents a node in the cluster.
A node could represent an entity available in the network that is not necessarily running an OSGi framework, such as a database or a load balancer.

section.title: public Map<String, Object> getMetrics(String... names)

formalpara.title: names
formalpara.para: a set of metric names that have to be obtained from the node. Of no names are specified all available metrics will be obtained. If a metric is requested that is not available by the node this metric is ignored and not present in the returned map.

section.para: Get the current metrics or other dynamic data from the node. Nodes may support custom metrics and as such the caller can request those metrics by name. The caller can specify the metric names to avoid having to compute and send all metrics over, if the caller is only interested in a subset of the available metrics.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: Map with the current node metrics
